name: db-splice-equivalence-was-unrecorded
body:
source: `src/splice/apply.rs:156` cites `domain.constraint.db-splice-equivalence`, and `tests/splice_e2e.rs:1039`/`:1933` name it as the law they prove.

Inconsistency: no `domain.constraint.db-splice-equivalence` node existed under `apg/layers/**` — a `MATCH (n:Constraint)` enumeration did not list it, a targeted FQN lookup returned nothing, a `CONTAINS 'equiv'` search returned nothing, and a filename search under `apg/layers/` found no such file. The code referenced a durable-spec law that was never authored.

Resolution: authored `domain.constraint.db-splice-equivalence` (attached to `domain.group.splice-equivalence`) and extended it to the authored/transient tables, which the original code comment scoped to "a full rebuild keeps" for code tables only. [autonomous]
